summary: Supplied evidence supports discoverable setup and validation guidance, usable architecture and domain documentation, focused documentation routing, a designated memory capture location, and explicit human consultation categories. Environment reliability and validation behavior remain unverified. Maintenance history, technical safety enforcement, and habitual feedback capture are not established. Instruction scoping, task decomposition, and observability remain unassessed because the bounded evidence does not support a level or an absence finding.
